messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: I booked a ticket for next month but cannot travel now. Can I cancel it and get a refund?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can check the fare rules for your ticket. Refund eligibility and any cancellation fee depend on the fare conditions you accepted when booking.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: Please check it and tell me the available options before I cancel.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I will review the ticket fare rules and explain the refund amount, fee, and any credit option before making a change.
